endpoints.title: Remove Tag From Multiple Views

endpoints.title: Remove Multiple Tags From View
endpoints.permission_required: The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or Organization Admin, or a Workspace Admin, or the View Owner, or any user with Edit Design permission on the view. Read-only users are rejected with 8180.

endpoints.title: Read Report Metadata

endpoints.title: Create Dashboard

endpoints.permission_required: The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or Organization Admin, or a Workspace Admin, or any user with Publish permission on the view, or any user with Make Public permission on the view.

endpoints.permission_required: The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or Organization Admin, or a Workspace Admin, or any user with Publish permission or Make Public permission on the view. In every case the organization or the workspace must be enabled for Embedded Analytics, otherwise 8023.

endpoints.permission_required: The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the organization. The caller must also hold Publish permission or Make Public permission on the view, and the organization or workspace must be enabled for Embedded Analytics, otherwise 8023.
